additions.name: Sabey SDC Umatilla Data Center Campus — current campus build

status.summary: Sabey reports that the first steel has risen at SDC Umatilla, its new data centre campus in Northeast Oregon, marked by a Going Vertical ceremony on 15 July 2026 and announced on 22 July. The release says the project has moved from planning, engineering and site preparation into the vertical phase, with hundreds of skilled tradespeople expected over the coming months. Building construction is established; completion and operation are not.

locator.precision: Centroid returned by the Umatilla County tax-lot service for tax lot 5N28130000200 (31266 Wanapa Rd, 55.7 stated acres, about 590 by 430 m), owned by SDC Umatilla I LLC. It locates the campus property, not a building, a surveyed campus boundary or the current works extent.
locator.identity_review: Sabey names the campus SDC Umatilla in Northeast Oregon without an address. The county tax-lot record lists SDC UMATILLA I LLC in care of Sabey Corporation, Seattle, as the mailing owner of tax lot 5N28130000200 at 31266 Wanapa Rd, Umatilla, and the service returns exactly one feature for that TLID. The owner name matches the project name and Sabey's headquarters, and the 55.7-acre lot matches the roughly 60-acre site sought in the 16 October hold. The city of Umatilla's centre and Sabey's head-office address are not used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The county service publishes no positional accuracy for tax lots; the centroid represents a property of roughly 590 by 430 m.

roles.party: SDC Umatilla I LLC (c/o Sabey Corporation)

additions.distinctness_review: Searched sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json and identity-mapping.json of the 516-site base for Umatilla, Wanapa, Oregon and tax lot 5N28130000200 with no site match (the only Oregon mention is unrelated evidence text); the six Sabey records are its Washington, Virginia and Indiana campuses. The nearest existing site is Bitdeer Wenatchee, 181.1 km away. The 16 October holds file (sources/research-countries-2026-10-16-thirtyfirst-holds.json) held this same candidate for want of a locator and is not a separate record.
additions.successor_review: The 22 July release is Sabey's latest statement captured for SDC Umatilla; no later completion, opening, pause or cancellation report was found in the 16 October capture of the lane. The status is kept at under construction; the release's expectation of work over the coming months is a forecast.
